measures.Name: SenioCitizen in %
measures.Expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNT('01 Churn-Dataset'[SeniorCitizenChurn]),'01 Churn-Dataset'[SeniorCitizenChurn]=1,'01 Churn-Dataset'[Churn]="Yes"), CALCULATE(COUNT('01 Churn-Dataset'[SeniorCitizenChurn]),'01 Churn-Dataset'[Churn]="Yes"), 0)

measures.Name: Partner in %
measures.Expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNT('01 Churn-Dataset'[Partner]),'01 Churn-Dataset'[Partner]="Yes",'01 Churn-Dataset'[Churn]="Yes"), CALCULATE(COUNT('01 Churn-Dataset'[Partner]), '01 Churn-Dataset'[Churn]="Yes"), 0)

measures.Name: Dependent in %
measures.Expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNT('01 Churn-Dataset'[Dependents]), '01 Churn-Dataset'[Dependents]="Yes",'01 Churn-Dataset'[Churn]="Yes"), CALCULATE(COUNT('01 Churn-Dataset'[Dependents]),'01 Churn-Dataset'[Churn]="Yes"), 0)

calculatedColumns.Expression: SWITCH(TRUE(),'01 Churn-Dataset'[tenure]<=12,"< 1 year",'01 Churn-Dataset'[tenure]<=24,"< 2 years",'01 Churn-Dataset'[tenure]<=36,"< 3 years",'01 Churn-Dataset'[tenure]<=48,"< 4 years", '01 Churn-Dataset'[tenure]<=60,"< 5 years",'01 Churn-Dataset'[tenure]<=72,"< 6 years")

measures.Name: # leavers
measures.Expression: CALCULATE(COUNT('Pharma Group AG'[FY20 leaver?]), 'Pharma Group AG'[FY20 leaver?]="Yes")

measures.Name: % employees promoted
measures.Expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNT('Pharma Group AG'[In base group for Promotion FY21]),'Pharma Group AG'[Promotion in FY21?]="Yes"), CALCULATE(COUNT('Pharma Group AG'[Promotion in FY21?]), 'Pharma Group AG'[In base group for Promotion FY21]="Yes"))

measures.Name: % women promoted
measures.Expression: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNT('Pharma Group AG'[In base group for Promotion FY21]),'Pharma Group AG'[Promotion in FY21?]="Yes", 'Pharma Group AG'[Gender]="Female"), CALCULATE(COUNT('Pharma Group AG'[Promotion in FY21?]),'Pharma Group AG'[Promotion in FY21?]="Yes"))

measures.Name: % hire men
measures.Expression: DIVIDE('Pharma Group AG'[# men], 'Pharma Group AG'[# men]+[# women])

measures.Name: % hire women
measures.Expression: DIVIDE('Pharma Group AG'[# women], 'Pharma Group AG'[# men]+[# women])

measures.Name: # before hire
measures.Expression: CALCULATE(COUNT('Pharma Group AG'[Employee ID]),'Pharma Group AG'[In base group for turnover FY20]="Y")

measures.Name: average # employee
measures.Expression: ([# before hire] + 'Pharma Group AG'[# after hire])/2

measures.Name: Avg performamnce (men)
measures.Expression: CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Pharma Group AG'[FY20 Performance Rating]),'Pharma Group AG'[Gender]="Male")

measures.Name: Avg performamnce (women)
measures.Expression: CALCULATE(AVERAGE('Pharma Group AG'[FY20 Performance Rating]),'Pharma Group AG'[Gender]="Female")
